Population.evidence_source: [/page/8/Text/7] The deceased were understood as perfectionists based upon their strong engagement in work, study, and career and were perceived to be very successful and well-functioning men. All victims grew up with both a mother and father-figure in a comfortable financial environment. Even though the suicide occurred for relatives and friends "without warning," in retrospect, the informants nonetheless considered the suicides as the end of a process that evolved over time.

Type.evidence_source: [/page/8/Text/7] Even though the suicide occurred for relatives and friends "without warning," in retrospect, the informants nonetheless considered the suicides as the end of a process that evolved over time. More specifically, the informants in all cases linked the vulnerability to suicide to the deceased's experiences during childhood and adolescence.
